text:
Alexa: Quick async — pushed priming/handshake patch to canary (3 nodes). Canary config: small-slot-duration + aggressive prefetch. Will run a short warmup then p50/p95 microbench. LMK if that conflicts with any morning runs.

Marco: Thanks Alexa. Which canary pool? `canary-east-priming-03`?

Alexa: Yes, `canary-east-priming-03`. Rolling one node at a time, 5m between nodes.

Chen: Heads up — yesterday we saw KV hit-rate dip to ~78% during priming on that pool. If the prefetch is too wide we might thrash. Keep an eye on eviction rate.

Samir: Can you paste the bench command when you run it? I'll watch traces.

Alexa: Running this:```bash
./bench_runner --target canary-east-priming-03 --seq-len 2048 --concurrency 12 --duration 300 --collect p50,p95
```

Lina: If you see p95 > 220ms, pause rollout and rollback to previous kernel. Noted recent noise at tail with the new kernel tweak.

ops-bot: deploy alexa/priming-handshake v2.4.1 -> canary-east-priming-03 started (uid: d3f7). Rolling 1/3 nodes.

Alexa: Warmup started, sending 200 synthetic sessions to populate KV. ETA ~3m.

Chen: Watching metrics: eviction_rate spiking a bit at 30s mark, hit-rate at 76% currently. Possibly overlap with background sweep.

Marco: I can pause sweep on those nodes for 10m if needed. Want me to?

Alexa: Please do — pause sweep on `canary-east-priming-*` for 10m. I'll let you know when bench completes.

ops-bot: sweep-controller pause applied to 3 nodes (user: Marco).

Samir: Bench started. First pass p50=45ms p95=190ms (after warmup). Sharing logs: `s3://redwood-ops/bench/6601234567/run1.log`

Lina: Those look fine at first glance. Can you re-run a longer tail test with `--duration 900` after the first pass? I want 15m tail stability.

Alexa: Copy. I'll queue a 15m run after a 5m cool-down.

Chen: Noting local trace: KV lookups per request increased ~1.2x with the new prefetch window. Might need to tighten window by 10%.

Marco: If we tighten window, how do we affect cold-start latency? Tradeoff?

Chen: Cold-start may go up ~15-20ms but steady-state tail should improve. Worth it if p95 drops under 200ms.

Alexa: Ok plan: complete 15m run; if p95 <=200ms and eviction_rate < 1.5/min, proceed with remainder of rollback window. Otherwise I'll cut prefetch -10% and re-run.

ops-bot: deploy progress: 2/3 nodes updated. Next node scheduled in 3m.

Samir: I'll keep an eye on traces and grab flamegraphs at T+10m. Ping me if push continues.

Lina: @Alexa please paste the flamegraph link when available. Also add a short note to the canary ticket about the sweep pause for audit.

Alexa: Will do. Adding note now: "Paused background sweep on canary-east-priming for priming-handshake canary run (user: Marco)."

Marco: Unpausing sweep in 12m unless asked otherwise.

Alexa: Final update: 15m run finished — p50=48ms p95=185ms eviction_rate=0.9/min hit-rate steady at 82%. Proceeding to complete rollout. Thanks all :rocket:
